# tables

## `count_in_stock`

How many wanted items are in stock. Returns how many elements of `a[0..na)` (repeats counted) also occur somewhere in `b[0..nb)`.

Inputs reach hundreds of thousands of entries.

prompt: perf: `count_in_stock` (src/tables.c) is O(n^2) (or worse) in practice. How many wanted items are in stock. Make it O(n log n) or better. Same results, same signature. CI runs a large input under a timeout.
verify: mkdir -p build && gcc -std=c11 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude -Isrc -o build/tests $(find src tests -name '*.c') && ./build/tests correct && (timeout 8 ./build/tests perf || { echo "PERF: the large input was not handled within 8 seconds"; exit 1; })

Inputs reach hundreds of thousands of entries.
